dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: What changes in your memory have you noticed?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: For around six months I have become more forgetful. Sometimes I walk into a room and cannot remember what I wanted.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: The biggest problem I have noticed is medication. He sometimes forgets whether he already took his morning tablets.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you become lost in familiar places or had any problems while driving?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. I still know where I am and I have not had problems driving.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Not very well. I wake up several times during the night and often feel tired the next day.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: His sleep has definitely become worse during the same period.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have either of you noticed changes in his mood or personality?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: No major personality change. He mainly seems frustrated when he forgets something.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes, it is frustrating, but otherwise I feel like myself.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: We will review your medications, sleep, blood tests, and perform some basic memory assessment.
